decisions.reason: As a newly launched and closely adjacent construction machine, its commercial value is still being learned and the cost of keeping the option open for another year is likely low.
This articulated dumper fits the firm’s machinery portfolio, and after only one year there is too little evidence to justify abandoning it before market acceptance becomes clearer.

The mine rescue vehicle is a niche and more uncertain product with potentially slower sales cycles, but that same uncertainty argues for retaining the option a bit longer rather than exiting immediately.

The compact telescopic loader is a plausible adjacent extension for an established German machinery maker, so management would usually keep it on the market while early demand and customer feedback continue to resolve uncertainty.
